text.en:
Partial Item Shipping from Antalya to Liverpool

Are you looking for a reliable solution away from the chaos of logistics processes? With the corporate solutions we offer for partial item shipping from Antalya to Liverpool, your items are collected from Antalya and delivered to your door in Liverpool.

Professional Packaging and Customs

The safety of your belongings is our priority. For fragile items, we use a "kraft paper + bubble wrap" combination. On the customs side, our expert team manages the procedures that have become more complex after Brexit on your behalf.

Partial Item Shipping Service Details

Technical details are at the forefront of our service focused on Partial (Groupage) Transport. You are only charged for the space your items occupy. It provides a cost advantage thanks to our regular weekly departures. Transport is carried out by combining with the loads of other customers (consolidation), and delivery time may be slightly extended. Additionally, it is the most economical option for those with a small amount of items and students.

Our Logistics Process from Antalya to Liverpool

For shipments from Antalya, we use road transport to access Europe. The distance between the two points is approximately 3,700 km, and our estimated delivery time is 14-16 days. We offer safe packaging with our Mediterranean region logistics network. We provide special solutions and advantages for those settling in the UK from touristic regions.

Process Steps

  • Survey: Volume detection at your address in Antalya.
  • Operation: Transport is performed by combining with other customers' loads (consolidation).
  • Customs: Export procedures from Antalya and import procedures in Liverpool.
  • Delivery: Scheduled delivery and installation support.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you have storage services?

Yes, we have secure warehouses in both Turkey and the UK. We can store your belongings for as long as you need.

Are there customs duties?

If you obtain ToR approval for personal effects, you won't pay taxes. You are only charged for the space your items occupy.

What does the insurance cover?

Our All-Risk insurance covers risks of accident, fire, and theft during the process from packaging to delivery of the items.

Conclusion and Contact

Choose Han Bros Cargo for partial item shipping from Antalya to Liverpool. Call us now to meet our Mediterranean region logistics network and benefit from our secure packaging advantages.
